name: Gross greenhouse gas emissions
headline: False
caveat: Gisborne Region industry and household emissions, in kilotonnes of CO₂ equivalent. Uses the production approach and the residence principle. Excludes consumption-based emissions. Earlier years can be revised.

name: Students attending school regularly
headline: False
caveat: Percentage of students in Gisborne Region state and state-integrated schools who attended more than 90% of the term. COVID-19 affected comparability in 2020 and 2021. Reporting changed from Term 1 2025. CSV dates are the corresponding calendar-quarter boundaries for indexing by term.

name: Estimated resident population
headline: True
caveat: Estimated at 30 June. Rebased after each census (2023 rebase).

name: Median age
headline: False
caveat: Half the population is older and half younger. Estimated at 30 June.

name: Business locations (geographic units)
headline: True
caveat: Business locations (geographic units) with economic activity, at February each year. Counts randomly rounded.

name: Employees in business locations
headline: False
caveat: Employee count at February. Counts randomly rounded.

name: Working-age people on a main benefit
headline: True
caveat: Working-age (18–64) recipients at the end of each quarter. Counts randomly rounded to base 3.

name: Jobseeker Support recipients
headline: True
caveat: Best Tairāwhiti-only labour-market signal: the HLFS unemployment rate is only published for Gisborne/Hawke's Bay combined.

name: Supported Living Payment recipients
headline: False
caveat: Includes carers and people with a health condition or disability; a rise is not necessarily negative.

name: Mean weekly rent, new bonds (geometric mean)
headline: True
caveat: Private-landlord bonds lodged in the month. Fixed random rounding; months with fewer than 5 bonds suppressed.

name: Social housing register applicants
headline: True
caveat: Housing Register plus Transfer Register, at month end.

name: Social housing places – community housing providers
headline: False

name: Emergency housing grants approved
headline: False
caveat: Emergency Housing Special Needs Grants. Monthly counts are small and volatile.

name: Children fully immunised at 6 months
headline: True
caveat: Rolling 12-month coverage by district of residence. National target is 95%.

name: Children fully immunised at 24 months
headline: True
caveat: Rolling 12-month coverage by district of residence. Health target: 95% by 24 months.

name: Road deaths and serious injuries
headline: True
caveat: Calendar year. CAS is live: recent years may still change. Current year is year-to-date.

name: Road deaths
headline: False
caveat: Small annual numbers; read multi-year trends, not single years.
